name: DART (Distance-Aware Replication on Tangent-planes)
definition: A pre-processing step that enriches the initial SfM point cloud by adding samples on local tangent planes, with disk radius growing with distance from the scene center, to address sparse seeding in periphery and low-texture regions.
summary: DART is a pre-processing method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that enriches sparse point clouds by generating samples on local tangent planes with radii scaled by distance from the scene center.
